styles.name: Black denim stud halter bib apron, two hip pockets, black contrast neck strap and waist ties through antique brass eyelets — Oliver Harvey, Wright Bros
styles.desc: DENIM BIB APRON · Two hip pockets, the right hip pocket as worn with a stitched pen pocket · Contrast black cotton waist ties through large antique brass eyelets at the waist · Antique brass rivets set to the top of all pockets · Contrast black cotton neck strap, stud fastened with antique brass capped studs · No red OH tax tab · Wright Bros logo set to the top centre of the bib in white · The black contrast version of OHAPP059703/153DEN (which has khaki ties and straps)
styles.lectra: FOHDENIM, variant 0597 — discard the right side as worn stud re-inforcement piece
fabrics: Black denim Art Murray 315 gsm 100% cotton, 1.50 m width (P and R) for the apron, eyelet re-inforcement pieces and pockets — rating 0.65 m, the same as All Costings; the sheet gives the location as B2, Sage holds the cloth at C5
Black 3110 100% cotton (P and R) for the neck strap and waist ties — rating 0.17 m; the sheet gives the location as A6, Sage holds the cloth at A4
trims: THREAD — COATS EPIC 80'S BLACK 09700 for all stitching, the ties and strap in matching thread — cost per metre
Set just below the base of the re-inforcement patch in the right side seam as worn, on top of the OH care label.

100% cotton · 50° wash · do not bleach · 2 dot iron · P dry clean · do not tumble dry. Set just below the base of the re-inforcement patch in the right side seam as worn, below the OH woven label. No red Oliver Harvey tax tab on this apron.
Antique brass capped studs, quality 050B: 4 x male (parts A/B) set to the neck strap. Sage holds quality 050 as the gilt 15 mm round spring fastener.
Antique brass capped studs, quality 050B: 2 x female (parts C/D) set to the bib.
30E/R AB 30 mm antique brass eyelets, 2 per apron. Set to the top of the side seams: centre of the eyelet 3 cm down from the top and 3 cm in from the side seam, finished.
The ring for each 30 mm eyelet: 2 per apron.
010B/7P - 011B antique brass invert nipple rivet and post, one at each top corner of each hip pocket: 4 per apron. No Sage code on the trims list.
mfg: Embroidery: the Wright Bros logo set to the top centre of the bib in white — see CUSTOMER BRANDING.
Make the waist ties in the black 3110 cotton, stitched in matching thread: bag out both ends and topstitch one side.
Make the neck strap in the black 3110 cotton, stitched in matching thread: bag out both ends and edgestitch one side.
Discard the right side as worn stud re-inforcement piece.

Neaten the long edge of the stud re-inforcement piece, turning onto the right side of the fabric, as the wrong side of the fabric is to be uppermost. Set to the left side as worn so it is included in the top of bib turning and the armhole turning. Set so the wrong side is uppermost on the finished garment.
Fold over the bib top 1 + 3.2 cm and topstitch 3 cm.
Set the re-inforcement patches for the eyelets, right side of the fabric uppermost.
Double turn the armholes and topstitch 6 mm.

Double turn the side seams and hem and topstitch 12 mm, enclosing the edges of the re-inforcement patches for the eyelets. Set the labels in the right side seam as worn, just below the base of the re-inforcement patch.
Set the hip pocket hems: turn 1 + 2 cm and twin needle topstitch, the bottom row of stitching 2 cm from the top of the pocket.
Set the lower hip pockets to the apron: top of the pocket 16 cm down from the finished armhole and 3.5 cm in from the finished side seam edge. Twin needle three sides.
Set the pen pocket stitch line, 3 cm wide x 13 cm deep, to the inside edge of the right pocket as worn.

Set the neck strap to the right side of the bib as worn, the edgestitched side of the strap to the inside of the neck as worn to reduce bulk. Set the strap to the bib, box stitch the strap and stitch the X detail. Position the strap so the edgestitching at the base of the strap end is in line with the 3 cm topstitching of the bib.

After the eyelets are set (finishing) the apron comes back for the waist ties: set the tie through the eyelet 4 cm and stitch down to secure, join on the inside as worn. Box stitch 2 stitch wide to the width of the strap.
fin: Set the rivets to the top corners of all pockets.
Set the eyelets: centre of the eyelet 3 cm in from the side seam and 3 cm down from the top of the side seam. The apron goes back to the machinist for the waist ties.

Set the studs: the female studs to the strap, central to the width, the first stud 1.5 cm from the end then 4 cm spacing (centre of stud), 4 studs in all. The male studs to the bib, 1.5 cm down and 1.5 cm in from the end of the bib, the second stud 4 cm below and 1.5 cm in from the edge, vertically down.
Check, trim, press and fold. Wrap in tissue, set the product sticker and set into a bag.
styles.tol: Across bib ± 1 cm · Neck strap ± 1 cm · Length from bib to hem ± 1.5 cm · Width at hem ± 1 cm · Pocket ± 0.5 cm
styles.brandPlace: Wright Bros Ltd logo set to the top centre of the bib in white thread, after make-up.
styles.note: Works order OHAPP059703/DEN for Wright Bros, Oliver Harvey (JH created 16/4/15; black contrast version for Wright Bros JH 16/11/17; sheet issued by Jane). The black contrast twin of OHAPP059703/153DEN, the khaki tie version: the same FOHDENIM 0597 apron on the same chart, with the neck strap and waist ties in black 3110 cotton (CO5003) instead of khaki, no red OH tax tab, and the Wright Bros logo on the bib. The logo is the record's own branding, so it is not a stock style. Rating 0.65 m on CO5003DEN, the same as All Costings. The photo on the sheet is kept as the placement image. The sheet is in works-orders/OHAPP059703DEN-WrightBros.xlsx.
